summary: Verified the dashboard already renders adaptive sprint state, recovery effects, and replanning events from persisted data.

messages.content: Dashboard support is ready: current and archived sprint views include replanning events, reassignment history, dependency changes, paused/blocked statuses, recovery links, and replay timeline markers.

decisions: No dashboard edit was needed: persisted replanning events feed activity and replay, task chips render paused/blocked/reassigned state, and blockers display recovery status.
Five focused dashboard replay and safe-rendering tests passed.
